## History

Ainslie came from a family with a history of consumption. After attending college for two years, his health collapsed, forcing him to return home to pursue farming. He subsequently lived in poverty alongside his wife.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015)_
